name: Date Range Picker
title: Date Range Picker
description: Smooth physics-driven date range picker calendar featuring dual-month navigation, quick presets rail, gliding thumb springs, and rolling label animations.
summary: A high-performance date range picker and calendar primitive featuring side-by-side months, seamless week-spanning range highlight capsules, physical spring-damped gliding indicators, directional month slide choreography, and rolling numeric text transitions.
highlights: Side-by-side dual-month calendar view with fluid month slide transitions
Connected continuous range capsules that stretch smoothly across week boundaries
Interactive hover preview projection between start date and hovered date
Physical spring-driven gliding indicator thumbs that travel smoothly from day to day
Quick preset rail with gliding spring background pill
Direction-aware rolling label odometer animations for summary dates and counts
Today date marker dot indicator adapting to selected edge states
Full keyboard navigation with arrow keys, page up/down, and home/end
Responsive single-month auto collapse on compact viewports
100% self-contained Tailwind CSS implementation with zero external CSS module dependencies
anatomy: <div className="relative inline-flex flex-col bg-[#161618] border border-zinc-800/80 rounded-2xl md:rounded-3xl p-5 md:p-6 shadow-2xl text-zinc-100"> (Root calendar card)
<div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-6 md:gap-8 items-stretch"> (Main body splitting presets rail and dual calendars)
<div className="flex flex-row md:flex-col gap-1 ..."> (Quick preset shortcuts rail)
<div className="relative flex-1"> (Dual-month calendars viewport with directional slide)
<Bar> (Continuous week-spanning capsule slice animated with physical stretch spring)
<Thumb> (Gliding white circular thumb pill with GLIDE spring)
<Month> (Month grid with weekday headers, day buttons, and today indicator)
<div className="mt-5 pt-4 border-t border-zinc-800/80 flex items-center justify-between"> (Footer with Rolling date summary and action buttons)

physics.engine: Time-derived Harmonic Damped Springs with Directional Motion Choreography
physics.description: Calculated harmonic spring dynamics converting visual duration and bounce into exact stiffness and damping ratios, powering fluid segment stretching, gliding thumbs, and rolling labels.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled date range selection containing start and end dates.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback triggered whenever the selected date range changes.

props.name: onApply
props.description: Callback invoked when clicking the Apply button with the chosen range.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Callback invoked when clicking the Cancel button.

props.name: presets
props.description: Custom preset options rendered in the left rail.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: Starting day of the week (0 for Sunday, 1 for Monday).

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale string for month titles, weekday headers, and date formatting.

props.name: months
props.description: Number of months displayed side-by-side (1, 2, or 'auto' for responsive collapse).

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS class names applied to the root container.
